-- Customer Segmentation Analysis
-- Segment customers based on their total sales and
-- the length of their relationship with the business.

WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT
        customer_key,

        -- Calculate the total sales generated by each customer
        SUM(sales_amount) AS [Total Sales],

        -- Calculate the customer's lifespan in months
        -- from their first order to their most recent order
        DATEDIFF(
            MONTH,
            MIN(order_date),
            MAX(order_date)
        ) AS [Lifespan (Months)]

    FROM fact_sales

    -- Group sales data by customer
    GROUP BY customer_key
),

CTE2 AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        -- Classify customers based on sales and lifespan
        CASE
            WHEN [Total Sales] >= 5000
                 AND [Lifespan (Months)] > 12
                THEN 'VIP Customer'

            WHEN [Total Sales] < 5000
                 AND [Lifespan (Months)] > 12
                THEN 'Regular Customer'

            ELSE 'New Customer'
        END AS [Customer Segment]

    FROM CTE
)

SELECT
    [Customer Segment],

    -- Count the number of customers in each segment
    COUNT(*) AS [Total Customers]

FROM CTE2

-- Group customers by their segment
GROUP BY [Customer Segment];
